newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran to launch satellite with Russian help.
newsitem.headline: Iran to launch satellite with Russian help.

text.p: Russia is to transfer aerospace technology to Iran and the Islamic republic's first educational satellite will be launched within the next three years, Tehran's ambassador in Moscow said in remarks published on Tuesday.
Mehdi Safari, in an interview with the daily newspaper Iran, said the transfer would be done in three stages under an agreement signed by the two countries.

He said the agreement provided for aerospace training by professors from the aerospace university in Moscow to start within the next two months at the Sheikh Bahaei university in the Iranian city of Isfahan.
Safari also said a daily cargo flight would begin between the cities of Tabriz and Moscow next month.
The ambassador said a cargo bureau would be established in Moscow to handle the purchase of equipment needed by the oil industry and for the design and construction of oil platforms.
